blurb: Jacaranda Golf Club is South Florida’s premier semi-private golf facility, featuring 36 holes of championship golf that are beautifully maintained throughout the year. The East & West courses, both rated four stars by Golf Digest, weave through a variety of ponds and canals, lending a tropical feel throughout.Paspalum tee boxes and fairways provide the most playable surfaces available.
